definition: An expression $a_{n}x^{n} + \dots + a_{1}x + a_{0}$ in which every power of $x$ is a whole number and every coefficient is a constant.
The highest power of $x$ with a non-zero coefficient; $4x^{3} - x + 7$ has degree $3$.
The coefficient $a_{n}$ of the highest power of $x$ in a polynomial; for $4x^{3} - x + 7$ it is $4$.
The number of times a factor $(x - a)$ appears in a polynomial; a root of multiplicity $2$ is a repeated root.
When a polynomial $f(x)$ is divided by $(x - a)$, the remainder is $f(a)$.
$(x - a)$ is a factor of a polynomial $f(x)$ exactly when $f(a) = 0$.
